assigned.title: Show reviewers the full review surface
assigned.acceptance: The diff and briefing presented to a reviewer cover the same surface the approval will bind to; a reviewer is never asked to approve a fingerprint over files it was not shown; one canonical reviewSurface helper is consumed by fingerprinting, stale-review checking, the review diff builder and the briefing, and a regression asserts the file set shown equals the file set fingerprinted

repo-validate.evidence: npm run check exit 0 under pinned Node 22, this round, including ai:validate, repo:validate and env:validate across development, test and production

unit.evidence: node scripts/test-ai-control-plane.mjs exit 0 under pinned Node 22, this round; the suite includes the regression that perturbs files and asserts the set shown to a reviewer equals the set the approval fingerprints, which is this task's whole acceptance

implementationBaseProvenance.reason: PL-AI-0005's implementation predates its claim and is already in committed history. The base was DERIVED: git log --reverse over scripts/review-surface.mjs gives the first commit that introduced the canonical helper this task exists to create, and this is that commit's parent. review-surface.mjs is the correct probe rather than any other declared path, because scripts/cloud and scripts/ai-control-plane.mjs both long predate the lane and would place the base before the work began. The commit window and both endpoints are published for the reviewer.

recommended.title: Contract module boundaries
recommended.acceptance: Shared vocabularies live in their own leaf modules, domain contracts live in one module each, index.ts is a re-export-only compatibility barrel rather than the authoritative public surface, and a wildcard exports map lets a new domain contract be added without touching package metadata or the barrel; no cycle-driven z.lazy remains and structural regressions prove the boundary rather than merely reflecting it; no schema behaviour changes

recommended.title: GitHub bridge for cross-agent review
recommended.acceptance: GitHub becomes the shared state bridge for Claude Desktop and OpenAI review without manual file copying
